message.content: Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa, branch feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component. This is a targeted fix on Step 4 (ZimmProductCardMedia molecule) of the SFCC-236 build, found during the VISUAL CHECKPOINT (a real-browser check, not by any Vitest test — this class of bug is structurally invisible to jsdom, which never lays out real pixels). The automated loop (Implementer → Tester → Orchestrator → Scorer) already PASSED this step twice on all coded axes; this is a separate, freshly-discovered rendering defect. ## The bug, already diagnosed and root-caused via live browser testing — do not re-diagnose, just fix and verify File: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx`. The file's `meta.decorators` wraps every story in: ```tsx (Story) => ( ), ``` In a real Chrome render (confirmed via Storybook, inspecting live computed styles — not jsdom), this decorator Box itself collapses to **8px wide** in every single-image story (`Default`, `WithHoverSwap`, `WithBadge`, `WithRemoveButton`, `SingleImage`) — NOT just the component inside it, the decorator `` element's own `getBoundingClientRect().width` is 8px. Since `ZimmProductCardMedia`'s entire recipe is a purely percentage-based chain (`root` → `scrollContainer` → `slide`, all `width: '100%'`, by deliberate design — this must stay fluid to fill an arbitrary real CSS Grid cell in production, per the "the card fills its grid cell" architecture decision), the whole component inherits that 8px collapse: the media root, the ``, everything renders at ~8×12px instead of a real card size. `MultipleImages` (3 images) does NOT exhibit this — its `scrollContainer` correctly resolves to 320px wide. This is a genuine, confirmed browser layout quirk: a `display:block` `Box` with only `maxWidth` set (no `width`) and a purely-percentage-relative descendant chain can resolve to its own min-content/shrink-to-fit size instead of stretching, in certain layout contexts — `maxWidth` alone does not reliably establish a *definite* width for percentage-resolution purposes the way an explicit `width` does. **Already confirmed as the fix, live, in the running browser:** setting `width: '320px'` explicitly on the decorator Box (in addition to or instead of `maxWidth`) immediately resolves the decorator to a real 320px, and the component's media root correctly follows to 320×480 (a proper 2:3 ratio). I tested this directly via `element.style.width = '320px'` on the live decorator node and watched `getBoundingClientRect()` go from `{width: 8, height: 12}` to `{width: 320, height: 480}`. **This is a story-file bug only. Do NOT touch `index.tsx` or `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts` at all** — the component's own percentage-based sizing is architecturally correct for its real intended consumer (an actual CSS Grid track in the eventual PLP, which always establishes a definite cell width, unlike a bare `Box maxWidth`). Adding any fixed/minimum width to the component's own recipe would be inventing an arbitrary pixel value with no Figma source and would contradict the "fluid card" decision already made for this build. The fix belongs entirely in the Storybook decorator, which needs to accurately simulate a real, definite-width container the way a production grid cell would. ## Required fix In `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia/index.stories.tsx`, change the decorator from: ```tsx ``` to: ```tsx ``` (Read the current decorator comment above it — it already explains this is Storybook-canvas-only sizing, not a production style, hence the raw px value being acceptable there per that comment's own reasoning; you may leave that comment as-is or tighten its wording slightly to note that `width` — not `maxWidth` — is required for the component's percentage-chain to resolve correctly in a real browser, your call on exact phrasing, but don't remove the existing "raw px is fine here, outside auditTokenUsage.mjs's scanned scope" rationale.) ## Verification — this bug is invisible to Vitest, so you MUST verify with a real browser, not just re-run the test suite 1. Run the existing suite to confirm nothing regressed: `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia`, `npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmProductCardMedia`. These will all stay green regardless of whether the fix is correct — they were green even WITH the bug present, since jsdom doesn't lay out real pixels. Passing these is necessary but proves nothing about this specific fix. 2. **You must independently confirm the fix in a real rendered browser.** A Storybook dev server is already running on `localhost:6006` (started separately, already serving this repo fresh — check `curl -s http://localhost:6006/index.json` to confirm it's up and has picked up your change via hot-reload; if the port isn't responding, say so in your report rather than guessing). For EACH of the 6 stories (`Default`, `WithHoverSwap`, `MultipleImages`, `WithBadge`, `WithRemoveButton`, `SingleImage`), navigate to `http://localhost:6006/?path=/story/commerce-zimmproductcardmedia--` and confirm via the DOM (not just eyeballing a screenshot) that the element with `data-card-slot="media"` has a real width close to 320px (not single-digit pixels). You have Storybook/browser tooling available in this environment — use it the same way you'd inspect any other live-rendered page. If you cannot access a browser tool in your environment, say so explicitly and describe exactly what a human must check instead — do not claim the visual fix is confirmed without having actually looked. 3. Re-run `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs` — confirm no new finding (story files are outside its scanned scope per the file's own existing comment, so this should be unaffected either way, but confirm). ## Scope Modify ONLY `index.stories.tsx`. Do not touch `index.tsx`, `zimmProductCardMedia.css.ts`, `index.test.tsx`, or any file outside this one. Do not stage or commit. Report: the exact before/after of the decorator line, confirmation of real-browser verification for all 6 stories (with the actual measured width for each, not just "looks fine"), and confirmation that the existing test suite is still green.

7

9	// keeps stories deterministic in CI. Same precedent as

17	  alt: 'Zimmermann silk midi dress, on model',
18	};

24	    alt: 'Zimmermann silk midi dress, back view',
25	  },
26	];
27	
28	const meta: Meta<typeof ZimmProductCardMedia> = {
29	  title: 'Commerce/ZimmProductCardMedia',
30	  component: ZimmProductCardMedia,
31	  parameters: { layout: 'padded' },
32	  decorators: [
33	    // Constrains the canvas preview to roughly a real card width — the component itself stays
34	    // fluid (width: 100%); this is Storybook-canvas-only sizing, not a production style, so a
35	    // raw px value here is fine (*.stories.tsx is outside auditTokenUsage.mjs's scanned scope).
36	    (Story) => (
37	      <Box maxWidth="320px">

42	};
43	export default meta;
44	
45	type Story = StoryObj<typeof ZimmProductCardMedia>;
46	
47	/** AC1 — minimal props: only the primary image, no hover swap, no gallery, no controls. */
48	export const Default: Story = {
49	  args: {
50	    primaryImage: PRIMARY_IMAGE,
51	    swapOnHover: false,
52	    showControls: false,
53	  },

55	
56	/** Two-image hover crossfade (desktop/hover-capable pointers only) — both images sit in the DOM
57	 *  simultaneously; the recipe's `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` rule controls which one is
58	 *  visible. */
59	export const WithHoverSwap: Story = {

62	    hoverImage: HOVER_IMAGE,
63	    swapOnHover: true,
64	    showControls: false,

67	
68	/** A full image gallery — desktop shows prev/next arrows, touch shows the slide indicator
69	 *  instead; native scroll-snap paging works on every pointer type regardless. */
70	export const MultipleImages: Story = {
